title: Eden's conjecture on local Lyapunov dimension
statement: For a smooth dissipative dynamical system with a global attractor, is the supremum of the local Lyapunov dimension on the attractor attained at an equilibrium or at an unstable periodic orbit contained in the attractor?

research_summary: Appears open in full generality (OPEN-TRIAGE). The local Lyapunov dimension is known to give rigorous Hausdorff-dimension bounds, and the conjecture that its supremum is attained at an equilibrium/unstable periodic orbit is confirmed in special (mostly low-dimensional or structurally stable) cases, but no general proof could be verified.
